fields.label: Screen Type
fields.description: Use the actual Desk screen type.

fields.label: Screen Name
fields.description: Page or Workspace name, or the DocType of a Form or List.

fields.label: Field Name
fields.description: Optional internal field name. Never a field value.

fields.label: Known Error Code
fields.description: An approved stable error code, never an exception body or business data.

fields.label: Guide Path
fields.description: Logical Compendium path, for example guide/search. No file paths or external URLs.

fields.label: Form Tour
fields.description: An existing native Frappe tour for the same screen.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Higher numbers first, after exact error and field matches.

fields.label: Next Instruction
fields.description: Approved instructions from the linked published article. This is not a finding about a record.

fields.label: Documented Cause
fields.description: For a known error only. Do not infer a cause from an exception body.

fields.label: Destination Screen
fields.description: Actual screen name. Form destinations are restricted to a field on this same form.

fields.label: Destination Field
fields.description: Internal field name on the same form; never a value or record identifier.

fields.label: Registered Check
fields.description: native_required_fields checks only unconditional mandatory fields. Other checks must be registered by an installed domain app; no executable settings.

fields.label: Record Check Roles
fields.description: At least one existing role is required. Document, scope and field permissions still apply.

fields.label: Record Check Fields
fields.description: One internal field per line. Only explicitly allowed fields reach the registered read-only check.

fields.label: Instruction When Specified Fields Are Present
fields.description: This does not certify completion of the business procedure.

fields.label: Instruction When a Check Finds a Gap
